newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-ISRAEL CHEMICALS A BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ISRAEL CHEMICALS A BUY.

text.p: Israel Chemicals Ltd (ICL) will see strong earnings growth over the next three years as the company's efficiency measures bear fruit, Sahar Securities and Investments Ltd said in a report released on Monday.
"The potential for greater efficiency at ICL is great and significant steps have already been taken by the group in this respect," said analyst Boaz Levitan, who tagged ICL a buy.
He forecast earnings per share (EPS) for the chemicals holding company of 0.24 shekel this year, rising to 0.30 shekel in 1998 and 0.34 shekel in 1999. Last year, ICL earned 0.19 shekel a share.
Levitan noted that ICL was trading at a relatively high price-to-earnings ratio but said it could be justified. He gave ICL a target price of 4.60 to five shekels a share.
ICL closed at 4.32 shekels on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Sunday, giving it a prospective price-to-earnings ratio of 18.

Sahar warned that the company would have to invest more in marketing because considerable new capacity had come on line in Asia and Eastern Europe. But, it said, ICL was well positioned to meet the challenge.
